name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a single, high-contrast focus ring that appears immediately on keyboard navigation. This ensures keyboard users can always see where they are, meeting WCAG 2.2 Level AA. The trade-off is visual clutter for mouse users, but it’s minimal and outweighed by accessibility needs.

name: Reader
text: The single high-contrast ring still forces sighted keyboard users to parse a moving target every time they tab—fatigue and cognitive load spike. Instead, keep the ring but make it appear instantly *and* stay visible until the next tab, then fade only after 5 seconds of inactivity. Test with 3 keyboard users on slow machines; if any struggle to track focus, revert to a static ring.
